name: chickpea
sowing_season: Rabi: October–November (central India mid-October, north India late October to early November)
soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam; black soil with stored moisture suits a rain-fed crop; pH 6.0–8.0

stages.name: Germination / Emergence
stages.description: Seeds sprout and seedlings come up in 7–10 days.
stages.irrigation: Sow in stored soil moisture. If the soil is dry, irrigate before sowing (palewa) rather than after.
stages.fertilizer: Basal: 50 kg DAP per acre (add 8 kg sulphur if the soil lacks it). Treat seed with Trichoderma 4 g + Carbendazim 1 g per kg, then Rhizobium + PSB 5 g per kg.
watch_for: Wilt and root rot in seedlings
Cutworms cutting seedlings at ground level
tips: Seed rate 30–40 kg per acre (more for bold kabuli seed)
Rows 30 cm apart; sow 8–10 cm deep in dry soil

stages.name: Vegetative / Branching
stages.description: Branches form — they decide how many pods the crop will carry.
stages.irrigation: If irrigated, give the first light irrigation at 40–45 days.
watch_for: Wilt — plants droop and dry in patches
Pod borer eggs and young caterpillars on leaves
tips: Nip the growing tips at 30–40 days (15–20 cm tall) for more branches

stages.name: Flowering
stages.description: Flowers open and the first pods set.
stages.irrigation: Do not irrigate at full flowering — it causes flower drop and too much leafy growth.
stages.fertilizer: In a rain-fed crop, a 2% urea spray (20 g per litre) at flowering helps.
watch_for: Grey mould in cloudy, humid weather
tips: Put up 5 pheromone traps and 20 bird perches per acre
Spray when 1–2 caterpillars are seen per metre of row

stages.name: Pod Formation / Pod Filling
stages.irrigation: If irrigated, one light irrigation at 70–75 days when the soil is dry.
watch_for: Pod borer making holes in pods
Frost on cold nights in north India
tips: For pod borer spray Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre
Neem seed kernel extract (5%) works on young caterpillars

stages.name: Maturity / Harvest
stages.description: Leaves and pods turn yellow-brown and seeds rattle in the pods.
watch_for: Pods shattering if harvest is late
tips: Harvest when most pods are brown
Dry the grain well and store it in airtight bags or with neem leaves

common_pests.name: Gram pod borer
common_pests.symptoms: Round holes in pods with a green-brown caterpillar half inside
common_pests.control: Emamectin benzoate 5 SG 0.4 g/litre; HaNPV 100 LE per acre in the evening

common_pests.name: Cutworm
common_pests.symptoms: Seedlings cut at ground level at night
common_pests.control: Chlorpyriphos 20 EC 2 ml/litre sprayed at the plant base in the evening

common_diseases.name: Fusarium wilt
common_diseases.symptoms: Plants droop, leaves yellow and dry; dark brown streak inside the stem
common_diseases.control: Resistant varieties, seed treatment with Trichoderma 4 g + Carbendazim 1 g per kg, 3-year crop rotation

common_diseases.name: Dry root rot
common_diseases.symptoms: Plants dry suddenly at flowering or podding; roots black and brittle
common_diseases.control: Seed treatment as above; avoid moisture stress at flowering

common_diseases.name: Ascochyta blight
common_diseases.symptoms: Brown spots with rings on leaves, stems and pods
